title: Russian Banderol Missile Strike on Central Pryluky Kills 3, Injures 12
detail: Russian forces struck the center of Pryluky, Chernihiv Oblast, with Banderol-type cruise missiles around 10:00 on September 14, hitting warehouse buildings of an agricultural enterprise and shattering windows in nearby apartment blocks. Three people were killed, including Oleksandr Shket, a prosecutor with the Pryluky District Prosecutor's Office, and the injury toll rose to 12 as more casualties were confirmed. Chernihiv regional prosecutors opened a war-crimes investigation into the strike.

title: Russian Glide Bomb Strike on Izium Injures Three, Including Two-Month-Old Infant
detail: A Russian guided aerial bomb struck the city of Izium in Kharkiv Oblast on September 14, injuring a 56-year-old man, a 34-year-old woman and a two-month-old infant, regional military administration head Oleh Syniehubov said. The strike destroyed four private homes and damaged five more houses and several passenger cars.
